name: Sub Account Identification 3
definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

FungibleIndicator.name: Fungible Indicator
FungibleIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the securities in the account are fungible, ie, interchangeable.

ActivityIndicator.name: Activity Indicator
ActivityIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there is activity reported in the statement.

BalanceForSubAccount.name: Balance For Sub Account
BalanceForSubAccount.definition: Net position of a segregated holding, in a single security, within the overall position held in a securities account.
